items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 22 at 10:48PM PST until November 24 at 4:00AM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, tidal overflow
flooding. For the Coastal Flood Warning, coastal flooding
expected.

* WHERE...North and Central Coast of Oregon, and South
Washington Coast.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 4 AM PST Tuesday.
For the Coastal Flood Warning, from 4 AM Tuesday to 4 AM PST
Friday.

* IMPACTS...Major flooding, up to two feet above ground level,
during high tides is expected along the immediate coast as well
as low lying areas near bays, sloughs, and the lower reaches of
the coastal rivers.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS... Coastal Flood Advisory means that tidal
overflow flooding of low-lying areas is expected due to high
tides. Coastal residents in the warned area should be alert for
rising water, and take appropriate action to protect life and
property.

A Coastal Flood Warning means that more significant
coastal flooding will occur. Shoreline roadways and beaches may
flood. Significant beach erosion is possible. Coastal residents
in the warned area should be alert for rising water, and take
appropriate action to protect life and property.
items.instruction:
A Coastal Flood Warning means that flooding is occurring or
imminent. Coastal residents in the warned area should be alert
for rising water, and take appropriate action to protect life and
property.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued November 22 at 12:03PM PST until November 24 at 4:00PM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, seas 8 to 13 ft at 13
seconds and south winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt.
For the Gale Warning, seas 13 to 18 ft at 17 seconds and
southeast winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 40 kt expected.

* WHERE...Inner Coastal Waters from Cape Shoalwater to Florence
out 10 NM.

* WHEN...Small Craft Advisory, until 10 PM PST Monday. Gale
Warning, from 10 PM Monday to 4 PM PST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
A Gale Warning means winds of 34 to 47 knots are imminent or
occurring. Operating a vessel in gale conditions requires
experience and properly equipped vessels. It is highly
recommended that mariners without the proper experience seek safe
harbor prior to the onset of gale conditions.
